title: Lior and the Wolf
author: Juniper Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
